name: sulfur + symphytum officinale whole
purpose: Antifungal. itch relief Helps relieve inflammation and irritation
uses: Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin 1-2 times daily or as needed. For first-time users,test on a small patch of skin before full application. Massage gently until fully absorbed. For bestresults,use after cleansing with the antifungal soap.
otcwarn: children under 2 years of age unless directed by a doctor if irritation occurs, symptoms persist for more than 2 weeks, or symptoms worsen after initial improvement.
